# Alex Merced Media

> AlexMercedMedia.com collects the videos, podcasts, articles and books of Alex Merced, Head of Developer Relations at Dremio. Most of it covers Apache Iceberg, the data lakehouse, agentic analytics and data engineering.

Alex Merced teaches developers how to build on the data lakehouse. He writes and talks about Apache Iceberg, Dremio, open-source software, agentic analytics, JavaScript, Python, Rust and Go.

## About

- [Alex Merced Media homepage](https://alexmercedmedia.com): Central hub aggregating Alex Merced's blogs, videos, podcasts, and books.

## Videos

- [Latest Videos](https://alexmercedmedia.com/videos): Tutorials, talks, and tech deep dives across Alex's YouTube channels.
- [Code, Data, and Tech with Alex Merced (@AlexMercedCoder)](https://www.youtube.com/@AlexMercedCoder): Programming, Web Dev, DevRel, and AI.
- [Understanding Data with Alex Merced (@AlexMercedData)](https://www.youtube.com/@AlexMercedData): Data Engineering, Lakehouse, and Apache Iceberg crash courses.

## Articles

- [Latest Articles](https://alexmercedmedia.com/blogs): Aggregated posts from all of Alex's blogs, 24 per page.
- [Apache Iceberg](https://alexmercedmedia.com/topics/iceberg): Articles, videos and podcast episodes on Apache Iceberg.
- [AI agents](https://alexmercedmedia.com/topics/agents): Articles, videos and podcast episodes on AI agents, agentic analytics and MCP.
- [Semantic layer](https://alexmercedmedia.com/topics/semantic-layer): Articles, videos and podcast episodes on semantic layers.
- [Alex Merced's Blog](https://alexmerced.blog): Personal tech blog.
- [Open Data Lakehouses for Everyone](https://amdatalakehouse.substack.com): Substack newsletter on data lakehouses (tech).
- [The Lovatarian](https://loveatarian.substack.com): Substack newsletter on politics and philosophy.
- [Alex Merced on Medium](https://medium.alexmerced.blog): Medium publication.

## Podcasts

- [Podcasts](https://alexmercedmedia.com/podcasts): Recent episodes from all shows.
- [Alex Merced Tech Podcast](https://host.alexmercedpodcast.com/feed/podcast/amtech): Data Engineering, Analytics, Lakehouse. Active.
- [Thoughts and Opinions of Alex Merced](https://host.alexmercedpodcast.com/feed/podcast/thoughts): Politics, Economics, Libertarian Commentary. Active.
- [DevRel & Developer Advocacy](https://host.alexmercedpodcast.com/feed/podcast/devadv): Developer Relations Careers. Periodic.
